Delete your TripWallet account

Last updated: 14 October 2026

Privacy policyDelete your account

You can request deletion of your TripWallet account and associated account data without reinstalling or signing in to the app.

Request deletion by email

  1. Email chakshitguleria2004@gmail.com from the email address registered with TripWallet.
  2. Use the subject TripWallet account deletion and state that you want your account deleted.
  3. If you no longer have access to that email, tell us so we can discuss a way to verify ownership. We may need ownership confirmation before deleting data. We will reply with the request status and any further steps.

Never send your password, email verification code, UPI PIN or bank credentials. This email route is a manual request, not an automatic deletion button.

Delete in the app

Sign in, open Profile → Delete my account, read the explanation and confirm.

What is deleted and what remains

Your sign-in account and profile are removed. Names, avatar links and UPI addresses on retained memberships are cleared or replaced with “Deleted account”. Shared expenses, shares, settlements and participant identifiers remain to preserve other members' financial history. Shared text may still contain personal details: identify any such records in your request so they can be reviewed. Trips you own with no other members are deleted; shared trip ownership transfers to another member.

The in-app deletion process clears the active account's local database on that device. For an email deletion request, clear app storage on your devices to remove cached copies. Copies exported by other members are not automatically removed. Provider logs, backups and support correspondence may remain for service, security or legal purposes under the applicable retention practices. See the privacy policy for details.
